0.original: Eo Tyr is looking particularly pleased with themself.

48.original: Oooh, sapling of the king! I have a fascinating delight to show you.

49.original: ...But he seems to have wandered off somewhere. Could you look for him, please?

50.original: And when I say “him” I mean...Another Anden. You'll know him once you find him─you'll see!

51.original: He can't have gone far. Go on, go on! Find Another Anden.

52.original: This loitering lump of leaves looks strikingly like an Anden you once knew. Perhaps this is what Eo Tyr is seeking.

54.original: This leafman is straining to communicate, but unlike Anden, it seems incapable of speech.

56.original: Now, I have prepared this sweet shrublet for a very special reason. Will you hear it?

57.original: As long as I have known him, I have always, <hex:021A020203>always<hex:021A020103> longed to speak with Anden. Oooh, how I hoped and pined.

58.original: Then suddenly, my wish came true! Now here I am, spending day after day talking and laughing and playing with you both. I don't think any pixie has ever known such fun.

59.original: That is why I wish to repay your kindness with a little gift─not a talking leafman, but a <hex:021A020203>walking<hex:021A020103> leafman! His name is “Anden III.”

61.original: I borrowed some of Original Anden's leaves after pruning him.<hex:02100103>Twist a branch here, nip a bud there─and there you have it! Oooh, isn't he adorable? Your very own Personal Anden!

62.original: Speaking of personal, I mustn't keep you long, lest the king think I'm trying to steal away their precious sapling.

63.original: As though I would, when I have Anden. Oooh, Anden!
